C0601.title: Supreme People's Court Typical Case: Wang and Others Used Virtual Currency to Transfer Telecom Fraud Proceeds
C0601.summary: In July 2025, the Supreme People's Court released typical cases on punishing crimes related to assistance for information network crimes. In one case, Wang, Zhang, and Zhao acquired bank cards to receive criminal funds, withdrew cash at several banks in Daqing, Heilongjiang, kept a 10% to 15% commission, and used the remaining funds to buy virtual currency for transfer to their upline. From August 5 to August 14, 2022, the bank cards received more than 400,000 yuan in fraud proceeds from 15 victims. The three defendants were convicted of concealing or disguising criminal proceeds.
